note: How each shared round feature maps onto the existing VisualCore framework and the unified-app features. 'existing' lists public types that exist today and are reused; 'home' names the module that receives new code ('(new)' marks a proposed module). Dispositions: reuse (audit and adapter only), extend (existing module grows), new (new capability), superseded (delivered by unified-app features; no separate gate). Rounds 3 to 12 share one list by feature number.

F01.note: Replaced by the pre-migration baseline, the two ledgers and UA-F00; no Round 1 device exit gate exists any more (C-03).

F02.note: As built (feature 202): RenderCapabilities also reports samples, draw buffers, colour attachments, vertex limits, vertex and integer precision, EGL version and extensions, missing entry points and the context generation, taken again after every context recreation; floorFindings() checks the OpenGL ES 3.0 minima; the evidence carries environment.renderer (RendererRecord); API compatibility stays with scripts/check_public_api.py. MSAA is reported, not enabled (ADR-0002).

F03.note: As built (feature 203): the clocks and generators are reused unchanged (golden sequences and committed digests identical); added SeedDerivation (named sub-seeds by label or index), owned SeededRandom.index(below:)/shuffle/pick/weightedIndex with one draw per index, a versioned SeededRandom.State, ShaderHash (CPU twin of vc/hash.glsl, vc_pcg bit-exact on the GPU) and NumericHygiene (finite, angle, wrap, quantize); rules and transform conventions in docs/architecture/determinism.md.

F04.note: As built (feature 204): ownership rules reused and proven on both runtimes; cache eviction now retires a program instead of deleting it (valid until released or the context ends; evictionCount, retiredProgramCount); RenderState (pure, presets opaque, alphaBlended, additive, opaque3D) and Pipeline applied by GLState.apply, which refuses and counts a released or stale program; offscreen targets with a 24-bit depth renderbuffer (depth: true), counted, pooled and released with the target. Session-level rules stay with UA-F03.

F05.note: Indexed mesh compiler with bevels, tubes, manifold and bounds validation on top of the existing Mesh and MeshRenderer.

F06.note: Typed per-domain shader parameters and safe GLSL ES compilation on the existing shader pipeline.

F07.note: Linear-colour emissive pass and mobile-safe bloom; the bloom and flash limiter of VisualCoreEffects are the starting point.

F08.note: Curve, ribbon and tube batches with parallel-transport frames.

F09.note: Instanced points exist; add beams and generic instancing.

F10.note: Spectral palettes plus non-colour clues (shape, pattern, label) for every colour-coded rule.

F11.note: Signed-distance and constructive-geometry library with CPU proxies that decide outcomes.

F12.note: Robust convex clipping and polygon operations, pure and host-tested.

F13.note: Shadow volumes or stencils and silhouette analysis; CPU decides, GPU portrays.

F14.note: Reversible history and scrubbing on the existing timeline and replay stream.

F15.note: Conic orbits and eclipse geometry, pure and host-tested.

F16.note: Grid, graph and route solvers used by solvability certification.

F17.note: Height-field transport with conservation checks on the existing field passes.

F18.note: Procedural terrain meshes and a sky dome.

F21.note: Diffusion, nutrient and viability field solver.

F22.note: Gesture recognizers and cameras exist; add analytic picking and world-space controls.

F23.note: Puzzle contract, seeded generation and solver certification; the lifecycle and digest parts are delivered by UA-F02.

F24.note: Content authoring, balancing and level catalogs generated and validated by tools.

F25.note: The shared shell is the one app: UA-F03 (session) and UA-F04 (launcher, navigation, settings).

F26.note: As built (feature 226): GestureArbiter (one gesture owns the touch, deterministic), GestureAlternatives with presenter gesture and native action sets, AnnouncementPlanner and HapticPlanner with rate limits, stateSignProblems for colour independence, transitionDuration for Reduce Motion, system players behind sinks, ExperienceFeedback route, and a haptics switch in Settings (ShellPreferences.haptics, absent = on). Reduce Motion and Reduce Flashing reused from UA-F04. Haptic feel and the system audits are device items.

F27.note: Entitlement is UA-F08 (one non-consumable); the zero-advertising audit is UA-F11. The source's 'no StoreKit' rule is superseded (C-02).

F28.note: Per-experience storage, migrations and atomic saves are UA-F05 on VisualCorePersistence.

F29.note: Golden, shader and mesh regression harness is part of the verification runner UA-F09.

F30.note: One app target: build matrix and CI are UA-F10 (C-05).

F31.note: Simulator part in UA-F09, device part in UA-F13.

F32.note: Quality profiles and pacing are UA-F06; D3 measurements happen after the lock.

F33.note: Distinctiveness audit is UA-F11; packaging is UA-F14 for the one app.

F34.note: Reconciliation before devices is LOCK-FREE-50 and UA-F12; its device part is DEVICE-RECONCILE-100 (C-18).

F01.note: Round boundary and prior-device exit are replaced by the ledgers and UA-F00 (C-03).

F02.note: Re-audit of the renderer API and GLSL ES assumptions for the round's families; no new code unless the audit finds a gap.

F03.note: Only the family-specific math that is genuinely missing, with error bounds and replay hashes.

F04.note: Extends the Round 2 mesh, ribbon and surface compilers (R02-F05, R02-F08).

F05.note: Shader variants and the emissive pass on top of R02-F06 and R02-F07.

F06.note: Family-specific batching and object picking on top of R02-F09 and R02-F22.

F07.note: Seeded generation, uniqueness and progression proofs on top of R02-F23 and R02-F24.

F08.note: Touch, camera and accessibility adapters on top of R02-F22 and R02-F26.

F09.note: Benchmarks are prepared by UA-F06 and measured on devices after the lock.

F11.note: Simulator evidence in UA-F09, device fixtures in UA-F13.

F12.note: Originality, legal and no-advertising audits are UA-F11; final reconciliation is UA-F12.
